Thanks again for the demo yesterday. BlueStreak is ready to annualize with Redwood but we need a predictable ramp rather than a single bump. High-level asks:

- Move from our current hosted commit (600M tokens/mo) to a staircase that lands at 2.4B tokens/mo over six months.
- Rate tiers that reflect the stepped commit (please include committed and overage bands).
- A soft-throttle/fallback plan for non-critical batch jobs so we don’t hit hard throttles during peaks.
- Invoice timing and PO path (we need to align with finance for July).

Attached a quick sizing workbook and an updated Mutual Action Plan — Eliza (procurement) will loop in final PO when pricing and dates are confirmed. Also need to confirm latency SLO for critical API paths (we target 95th p95 <= 120ms).

Attachments: [Attachment: Mutual Action Plan v2.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: Sizing.xlsx (XLSX)]

Best,

Eliza — thanks for the clear ask and the MAP/sizing. Quick proposal below (happy to walk through on a 30-min call):

Proposed staircase (monthly commit):
- Month 1: 900M tokens (pilot month at 50% of Step 1 accepted)
- Month 2: 1.2B tokens
- Month 3: 1.6B tokens
- Month 4: 2.0B tokens
- Month 5-6+: 2.4B tokens (annualize at month 6)

Pricing summary (committed rates / overage):
- Step 1 unit: $0.0018 per token committed, overage $0.0022 per token
- Stepped discounts applied as tiers mature; final committed unit at 2.4B = $0.00135 per token

Fallback and soft-throttle plan:
- For non-critical batch workloads we can route to a lower-cost model variant (same API surface) — automatic fallback policy when sustained >85% commit is observed for 10m windows.
- We will enable KV-prefix caching and aggressive batching for background jobs to reduce token burn.

Pilot: we can do Month 1 as a 30-day pilot at 50% of Step 1 (900M commit, billed as committed but with a one-time credit if you decide not to proceed to month 2).

Next steps I recommend:
1) Kimberly to confirm invoicing cadence and draft order form.
2) DocuSign order once PO path is confirmed.
3) Ops run a short pre-cutover checklist (latency baselines / traffic shaping rules).

If that all sounds OK I’ll circulate an order form and update the MAP with dates. Available for a call Wednesday 10–11 PT.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Exec — Redwood Inference
